labels.text: Section 1(c) as applied for the year: the fourth lowest rate of the table for unmarried individuals (36 percent for years before 2018, 24 percent for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2017). Read by the section 3402(r) and section 3406 withholding of the employment package. Values repeat the rate column of the rate-schedule-1986-unmarried and rate-schedule-tcja-unmarried sidecars.
section 1(c) table: 15, 28, 31, 36, 39.6 percent; the fourth lowest is 36 percent
